posts.author: Randar
posts.body: I have animated a small cutscene. I use the movie function to have it play, but I am not able to have sound effects or text display while the movie is playing. Is there a better way to have an animation play than using the "movie" function?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the movie mutes all other sound because it is expected to have its own sound.
If you made the sound part of the movie, you would be able top hear it the same way as if you played the movie with windows media player or whatever other program.
you can create your own animations including sound with a little trick that was added in the later updates to MZ.
in the database, animation tab, go to an empty animation slot.
right-click on the ID/name slot and select MV-compatible data
you'll then get a different setting field where you can create an animation from pictures and sounds without using effekser.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the folder is img/animations
the pictures are supposed to be png with a width of 960 pixel (5 times 192) with a height that is a multiple of 192
each animation cell is supposed to be 192x192 pixels with five cells per row, and you can either zoom them or split larger pictures between cells and reassemble them in the animation tab (although thatt is a bit of work if you try to move assembled parts over the screen)
The animation cell format is identical from both VXA and MV, so I suggest looking for a sale from either to get the licence to use their animation sheets - VXA is for sale for less than 10$ several times a year through steam resellers (including now):
